packages/orchestrator-scheduler-truth/in.notes: Shared scheduler truth primitive that records lane/file ownership, dependency readiness, verifier cost, collision risk, observed peak concurrency, unique agents, active worker minutes, idle gaps, assignment latency, and scale-credit eligibility requiring productive landed merges when configured.

packages/orchestrator-run-state/index.mj.label: Shared orchestrator run-state reducer and terminal truth semantics
packages/orchestrator-run-state/index.mj.notes: Central run-state reducer for local/remote/worker/sync/supervisor/terminalizer truth, explicit terminal states, contradiction detection, continuation decisions, and durable terminal artifact writes.
